parsed.name: USB列车ID采集器
parsed.description: 用于通过USB串行接口接收并解析列车ID与时间信息的通用设备/采集模块，可在独立进程中持续读取数据帧并将原始数据写入磁盘，以降低对主数据接收流程的影响。
parsed.description_en: A generic USB serial device/component for receiving and parsing Train ID and timing information. It runs in a separate process to continuously read framed data and write raw data to disk while minimizing impact on the main data reception path.

actions.description: 配置串行接口并连接USB设备。
actions.description_en: Configure the serial interface and connect to the USB device.

actions.description: 在独立进程中循环读取USB数据帧，解析列车ID和时间信息，并将原始数据写入文件直到收到关闭指令。
actions.description_en: Continuously read framed data from the USB interface in a separate process, parse Train ID and timing information, and write raw data to file until a shutdown command is received.
